notes.title: Neon Runners Playtest on Steam February 28, 2024 - March 1, 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858397/1d32785a363508b6fb19830aa2951a7a0132df2b.gif[/img]

After a year of development on Neon Runners, we're thrilled to announce a two-day playtest event available on Steam.


[h3]➤ Overview of the Playtest[/h3]
To kick off the playtest, streamers Bruce Greene, Aplfisher, Timdoggrev, and TsuBunnii will be playing and live streaming Neon Runners on Twitch.

[h3]➤ Playtest Schedule[/h3]
The event will run from February 28, 2024, at 2 PM PST until March 1, 2024, at 2 PM PST, lasting for a total of 48 hours.

[h3]➤ Participation Details[/h3]
To join, click the "Request Access" button on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2785860/Neon_Runners/]Steam store page[/url]. Access will be granted until the end of the playtest period on March 1st, 2024, at 2 PM PST.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858397/1143816855ce9499073c43a0e4e01701bd253c3b.png[/img]

[h3]➤ Feedback[/h3]
Please join [url=https://discord.com/invite/neonrunners]Discord Server[/url] and share your thoughts in the #feedback channel.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/neonrunners][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858397/a1485d6ce8895d65fb64ffb325cd55ced804ef07.png[/img][/url]


Thanks,
